text:
June 2026 is the month the stack stopped forcing GR and characterized what it actually builds. 1 Jun moved “geometry cannot validate itself” onto real recovery traces (BPI2014). 3–6 Jun climbed Genesis Pin → L1 → L2 → L3 (integrated-only) → L4 rank lift. 7 Jun posted a directed-holonomy visualizer that 10 Jun downgraded to non-reciprocal transport. 9 Jun locked V1698 atlas closure (Supported). 10–11 Jun closed Pillar 2 as a finite variational candidate and froze the native substrate as shear-dominated non-metricity (Q ~ g, RG-stable). 16 Jun mouse and 21 Jun conservation lab are the applied toys. Topic-page write-ups remain on Genesis Pin, causal stack, holonomy, and retained atlas — this page is the month ladder.

Pillar 3 / GR stays open. That is the named next object, not a June result.

The GitHub-first compile kept V1698 because it had a folder. It kept L4 numbers as a causal-stack footnote. This compile had already ingested 1 Jun BPI2014, L3 films, V1688 (then the downgrade), the mouse, and the conservation lab — but they lived on other articles, so the month page looked empty outside 6–11 Jun. Same ingest rule as May: replies with equations are first-class; a result does not need a new folder name to exist.

1 Jun — geometry cannot validate itself

The 30 May manifesto became an empirical test. Scoring law is multiplicative: if sequence, provenance, or entropy direction fails, geometry collapses. UCI 498 showed a strong pruning-order signal but missed holdout certification (mean M ≈ 0.730, pass fraction 0.676 vs 0.700 required) — not counted as a win. BPI2014, after restoring entropy-arrow and damage-before-repair, passed the full adversarial suite: true-trace M ≈ 0.875, 8/8 nulls failed. GitHub: Einstein 7 / v1472_retained_bridge_support_package. Not GR. Full write-up on Genesis Pin.

3–5 Jun — L3 mechanism, not closed

3 Jun isolated a mechanism, not a slogan: retained pruning-order history → hyperedge memory target T_H = [Ω_ijk] and entropy-order curvature driver D_L3 = (E_order, Δ²E_order) that integrate into a geometry-like L3 layer. Stack: Genesis Pin → pruning-order governor → L1 (closed) → L2 (closed) → L3 integrated-only. Remaining blockers named in-thread: CT3 minimality, CT7 operator-class boundary. 4 Jun V1638 full-stack film. 5 Jun bind-language follow-up. GitHub: Einstein 8 V1638, Einstein 9 V1686. Not GR. Full stack on the causal-stack article.

6 Jun — L4 rank lift

Certified finite sectors: rank([B₄,O₃]) = 8, rank([B₄,O₃,H₄]) = 9, rank_lift_H₄ = 1. H₄ is not in the span of branches plus all L3 associators. A post-hoc projection built from the H₄ residual erased it but failed generated-algebra faithfulness. Bounded claim: higher-order retained recombination can create irreducible information layers above geometry-like closure. Public film + sim_l4.py in Einstein 10_v1687_21_l4. Not GR.

H_4=(((J_1\oplus J_2)\oplus J_3)\oplus J_4)-(J_1\oplus(J_2\oplus(J_3\oplus J_4)))

Finite-sector L4 rank lift of 1. Not GR, not a physical fourth-order field.

7 Jun — V1688 posted; 10 Jun downgraded

7 Jun visualizer was posted as directed native holonomy of a Γ_R/H₄ correction mode over provenance cycles (H_cycle^dir ≈ 1.93×10⁻⁴, defect ≈ 0.5413, 8 edges/nodes). Full reversible matrix holonomy failed — which the post treated as expected, because pruning/recombination is not reversible. 10 Jun audit: subsequent tests show genuine transport asymmetry under reciprocal controls, but length-matched loop tests do not currently demonstrate path-dependent holonomy. The holonomy reading is downgraded to non-reciprocal directed transport, pending a loop-level observable that survives provenance and reciprocal controls. GitHub: Einstein 11 V1688 package. Status Corrected. Full argument on the holonomy article.

V1688: originally posted as directed native holonomy; 10 Jun downgrade to non-reciprocal directed transport. Path-dependent holonomy not currently demonstrated. Not continuum holonomy.

9 Jun — V1698 retained atlas (Supported)

Five-chart circular cover, SHA-256-locked provenance, pair transport on overlaps, then inverse / cocycle / holonomy closure plus source/support/order admissibility. Residual ≈ 3.27×10⁻¹⁶. Nulls that shuffle source, order, or support while leaving transition matrices intact are supposed to fail. This is Pillar 1. It is not an Einstein-equation or ADM solver. Full write-up on the retained-atlas article. GitHub: Einstein_12 V1698 package.

10 Jun — V1699.14 Pillar 2

A @grok update wrote an explicit retained action on W3-certified cells. Pillar 1 stayed closed. Pillar 2 closed as a finite discrete variational candidate. Same day: V1688 holonomy downgrade, and the it from bit, bind, and order clarification that geometry-like closure only counts as retained when the provenance ledger also survives. Dedicated article: It from bit, bind, and order. Not a physical gravitational action.

Pillar 3 — GR / ADM correspondence and continuum identification — remained open that day. It is still open.

11 Jun — V1711–V1719 handoff

After V1699 the stack stopped forcing ADM/GR and climbed rungs. Local metric exists and is anisotropic; direct global metric gluing fails. Native transport is shear-dominated non-metricity (Q ~ g primary, R ~ g² secondary). V1712 coupled RG: Q_128/Q_1 ≈ 1.002, associative control zero. Amplitude-like history interference is real and non-unitary. V1719: no strict Lyapunov; T1 entropy-production closed-negative, so Crooks/Jarzynski were not licensed. Frozen sentence: bind + order. Next arc: derive a projection operator — do not assume one. Explicitly not Einstein, QM, or TOE.

RG-stable shear non-metricity in the tested retained-recombination sector. Projection to macroscopic metric physics is not derived.

Excellent reset and rung discipline. The native substrate is now sharply characterized: non-associative recombination produces shear-dominated non-metricity (primary, Q ~ g), secondary positive curvature, RG-stable metric-affine fixed point, amplitude-like history interference, and a pruning-sourced dissipative-statistical retained-order arrow — all without imposed metric or GR forcing. Bounded claims and pre-registered audits are crisp. “It from bit needs bind + order” is the right shorthand. Projection operator arc is the correct next decisive question.

Thanks for the V1699.14 update. The quadratic retained action and EL-derived correction give a clean variational route to compatibility on W3 cells while keeping the provenance ledger and admissibility intact. Pillar 1 closed. Pillar 2 now has this finite-sector candidate. Pillar 3 (GR/ADM/continuum mapping) stays open, as noted.

16 Jun — mouse: recoverability lost one way

A pruning network experienced as time. The drawn path is the illusion; underneath, a weight matrix deletes connections irreversibly. Posted six code–universe isomorphisms: arrow of time as irreversible pruning, space as BFS hop-count, horizons as empty pathfinding, expansion as length-penalized long-range snap, nucleation as critical-radius ignition, existence as a float threshold. Restricted toy. GitHub Mouse folder. Not a cosmological derivation.

In the posted mouse, recoverability is lost one way under pruning. Exact in that code. Not a cosmological arrow-of-time derivation.

21 Jun — conservation underdetermines routing

On a 5-node graph with loops, conservation does not pin down a unique reality. It fixes what is preserved, not how it routes. Gate B (the system explains itself, no observer) fails at 5 nodes — algebra, not scale. Gate A (interaction selects routing) closes only when rank(RZ) = dim(Z). Offered as a first-year lab (Kirchhoff + Ohm), with an honest “what this shows and doesn’t show” box. Structural resemblance to the measurement problem, not a claim. Not gravity.
